annotations.title: SiriusXM Listen Free Event May 21 - June 1 - Senior Daily
SiriusXM Convenient & Commercial Free | Cadillac Ownership

content.text:
If you mean **free SiriusXM / satellite radio**, the legal options are basically:

1. **SiriusXM free trial**  
   SiriusXM offers free trial signups for eligible vehicles and/or streaming. You can start from SiriusXM’s official free-trial page. ([siriusxm.com](https://www.siriusxm.com/free-trial/?utm_source=openai))

2. **Inactive car radio free previews**  
   SiriusXM sometimes runs “Listen Free” events where inactive satellite radios in cars can receive a selection of channels for a limited time. A recent 2026 free-listen event ran **May 21–June 1, 2026**, so it has already ended as of today, **June 8, 2026**. ([seniordaily.com](https://www.seniordaily.com/siriusxm-free-listen-preview/?utm_source=openai))

3. **New or used vehicle trial**  
   Many new and some pre-owned vehicles with factory-installed SiriusXM include a trial subscription, often around **3 months**, depending on the automaker and model. ([cadillac.com](https://www.cadillac.com/technology/sirius-xm?utm_source=openai))

4. **Check your radio ID / VIN**  
   If your car has SiriusXM built in, tune to **Channel 0** to find your Radio ID, then check eligibility on SiriusXM’s site. Some trials may require a VIN or Radio ID.

There usually is **not a permanent free satellite-radio service** comparable to free AM/FM radio. If you want free long-term alternatives, use **AM/FM**, **HD Radio**, **iHeartRadio**, **TuneIn**, **Pandora free**, **Spotify free**, or local radio station apps.
